Name: Sam's Hair Makeover
Author: Chrysanthe
Description:
[b][size=4]Sam's Hair Makeover!
[/size][/b][size=2]Updated for SDV ver 1.4 and now compatible with CP.[/size]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/sUYkyUF.png[/img]

Say bye to Sam's broom-shaped hair and the super-mutant sidebang.
Now he can have hair like a proper Super Saiyan.


[img]http://i.imgur.com/5YmwaLG.gif[/img]     [img]http://i.imgur.com/Pg00QXr.gif[/img]

[b]Instructions:[code]﻿[/code][/b]
. [url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
. Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
. Run the game using SMAPI.

[size=2] I will upload the .xnb file if there are enough requests.[/size]
